This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

Qualifications

• Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.
• Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.
• Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
• Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.
• Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.
• Clear written and spoken communication skills.

Desired:

• Experience working on customer-facing applications.
• Good debugging skills on production systems.
• Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.
• Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.
Location
This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
.

Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
description:
## Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations
We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.
## About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/
Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.
Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.
Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.
## What you'll do
You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.
## 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness
Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.
Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.
Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).
Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.
Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.
Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.
## 2. Clinical knowledge base
Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.
Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.
Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.
Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.
Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.
Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.
By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.
## What we're looking for
We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.
## Must-haves
Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.
Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.
Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.
Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.
Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.
Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.
Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.
## Nice to have
Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.
A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.
Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).
Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.
Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.
Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.
## Probably not the right fit if
You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.
You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.
This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster.
In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries.
We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further.
## 🌲 About Spruce
Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.
We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.
We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. title: Data Engineer - Databricks Platform
description:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
Your Role
Passionate about building modern data platforms and transforming complex data into meaningful business insights? At Kyndryl, our Data Engineers design, develop, and optimize scalable data solutions that enable organizations to make informed, data-driven decisions.
As a Data Engineer specializing in Databricks, you will play a critical role in architecting and maintaining enterprise data platforms that support advanced analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and business intelligence initiatives. You will work across cloud environments, integrating diverse data sources and creating reliable data pipelines that deliver trusted, high-quality information to stakeholders.
This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, modern data architectures, and large-scale data engineering projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve business challenges through data innovation.
What You Will Do
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts using Databricks and cloud-native technologies.
• Build and optimize Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) processes to ensure high-quality, reliable, and accessible data.
• Integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring scalability, compliance, security, and adherence to data governance standards.
• Develop backend data services and application programming interfaces (APIs) to support data-driven applications and analytics solutions.
• Collaborate with Data Architects, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Developers, and Analytics teams to deliver business-focused data solutions.
• Support Agile delivery practices, continuous integration, code reviews, and operational excellence across the data platform lifecycle.
Your Future at Kyndryl
As a Data Engineer, you will have opportunities to deepen your expertise in modern cloud data platforms, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence initiatives. You can grow into roles such as Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Cloud Data Architect, Analytics Lead, or Technical Delivery Leader. Through continuous learning, certifications, and hands-on project experience, you will build highly sought-after skills in data engineering and digital transformation.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are eager to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, prioritize customer success, and naturally collaborate across diverse teams and stakeholders.
Required Skills and Experience
• Hands-on experience designing and developing data engineering solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Structured Query Language (SQL), and Python.
• Proven experience building and supporting Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) pipelines in cloud environments such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Strong knowledge of data warehousing, data lakes, data marts, data virtualization, and modern data architecture principles.
• Experience working with relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage platforms, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
• Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, data quality management, and regulatory compliance requirements.
• Familiarity with Agile development practices, application programming interfaces (APIs), version control, continuous integration, and collaborative software engineering methodologies.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Experience with Microsoft Fabric and lakehouse architecture.
• Knowledge of Apache Kafka, Apache Hadoop, or other big data technologies.
• Experience developing real-time and streaming data solutions.
• Exposure to web data extraction and automation technologies.
• Understanding of data modelling, analytics platforms, and business intelligence solutions.
• Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications.
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Cloud Specialist
description:

We are looking for a dynamic Cloud Specialist to drive cloud solution deployments, operational automation, and client-facing AI and Modern Workplace transformations across Singapore and Malaysia. title: Praktikum in KI-Schulungen, Prompting und AI Tools mit UX-Fokus
description:
Werde Teil unseres UX-Teams und unterstütze uns im Bereich KI-Training, Prompting sowie Enablement. Unser Ziel ist es, den Kolleginnen und Kollegen im gesamten Unternehmen den praktischen Nutzen moderner KI-Werkzeuge näherzubringen sowie diese nutzerzentriert zugänglich zu machen. Unsere Trainings- und Schulungsinhalte passen wir kontinuierlich an neue Features unserer eingesetzten Tools an – speziell aus der Gemini-, Antigravity- sowie Microsoft-Copilot-Familie. Gemeinsam im Team überlegen wir uns didaktische Konzepte, erproben neue Funktionen, bauen verständliche Folien und bereiten mit den Fachabteilungen reale Anwendungsfälle vor. Da wir in der UX-Abteilung verankert sind, blicken wir immer durch die Nutzerbrille: Du testest neue KI-Technologien sowie bewertest ganz gezielt deren Potenzial für die UX- und Arbeitswelt. Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches Praktikum mit steiler Lernkurve, in dem das kreative Anwenden, das Erstellen anschaulicher Lernformate sowie das Tüfteln an guten Prompts im Mittelpunkt stehen.
• Du überlegst dir gemeinsam mit uns, wie wir neue Features und Updates unserer Tools (vor allem Gemini, Antigravity, Copilot) praxisnah vermitteln sowie übersetzt diese in verständliche, ansprechende Folien. Zudem begleitest du uns aktiv bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung interaktiver Schulungen sowie Prompting-Workshops für Mitarbeitende weltweit. Auf Wunsch übernimmst du auch gerne kleinere Demo-Slots.
• Gemeinsam mit Fachabteilungen nimmst du konkrete Anforderungen auf, entwickelst gezielte Prompts und alltagsnahe Use Cases für unsere Schulungen. description:
Tutor - AI for Creative Industries
Location: Fully Remote - Anywhere in New Zealand
Full-time | Permanent | Remote
## About the Role:
We are seeking a creative and learner-centric Tutor to deliver the AI for Creative Industries strand of the New Zealand Certificate in Study and Employment Pathways (Level 4) within our online campus.
This programme supports ākonga and workforce learners to develop study and employment readiness, while developing foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence applied within creative contexts. The Creative strand is designed for learners exploring how AI tools and systems can support, enhance and optimize creative practice in ethical, human-centered, and culturally responsive ways.
This role is ideal for a tutor who is confident facilitating learning in a primarily asynchronous online environment and who can translate emerging AI concepts into practical, accessible learning experiences for creative learners.
## Key Responsibilities
• Facilitate learning in an online and largely asynchronous environment using the LMS and digital communication tools
• Support learners across Creative strand and shared core courses, including:
• Introduction to AI concepts and ethical awareness
• Study skills, digital literacy, and employment readiness
• AI technologies in creative practice
• AI-enabled creative workflows and tools
• Support ākonga to explore and evaluate AI tools used in creative industries (e.g. design, media, content creation, ideation, workflow optimization)
• Guide learners to analyse AI outputs and communicate reflective, well-reasoned insights as part of their creative practice
• Provide clear, timely and constructive online feedback on assessments
• Monitor learner engagement and proactively support learners who may be new to study, technology, or creative tools
• Maintain accurate academic records and contribute to continuous improvement of online delivery
## About You
We are seeking a creative professional who brings both industry insight and a passion for learner success. You have a background in the creative industries and are confident using emerging AI tools within creative workflows such as design, content creation, digital media, or creative production.
You are able to translate new and evolving AI capabilities into practical, engaging learning experiences for aspiring creatives. Rather than a purely technical AI background, you bring a practitioner’s perspective on how AI can enhance and support creative practice.
With a learner-centred and culturally responsive approach, you are committed to supporting diverse ākonga and fostering ethical, human-centred use of AI in creative industries.
Please note: This is a full-time teaching position. We are only able to consider candidates who can fully commit to the role and are not seeking this opportunity as a secondary or side position.
## Required Skills / Experience:
Professional background in the creative industries (e.g. design, digital media, content creation, creative technologies, or related fields)
Practical experience using AI-enabled tools within creative workflows
Ability to explain AI concepts in a creative, accessible, and learner-friendly way
Strong written communication skills and confidence engaging learners in an online environment
Teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or learner support experience (preferred but not essential)
Confidence supporting learners in an online or blended learning environment (advantageous)
A culturally responsive and inclusive approach aligned with Te Tiriti o Waitangi, supporting Māori, Pacific, and diverse learner communities
Commitment to ethical, responsible, and human-centred use of AI in creative practice

Yoobee Colleges prides itself on supporting a diverse and inclusive culture - open to inputs from creative people of all genders, ethnicity, identity, thought and experiences. We are fast movers, action orientated, keen innovators, and quick thinkers who enjoy a workplace that is inspiring and fun.

• Be a part of NZ’s Largest specialist creative & technology college
• Rewarding opportunity to support students in their journey pursuing creative and tech industries
• Strong commitment to your professional growth & development
• Amazing work culture that is highly collaborative and supportive

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in the role.
Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.
We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.
## Who are we?
At Yoobee Colleges, we believe learning should be defined by the exceptional. New Zealand’s largest specialist creative and technology college; we’ve been fuelling the creative and tech industries for over 30 years with talented Animators, Filmmakers, Designers, Techies, and Game Developers. We offer online delivery, alongside our campuses based in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.
Making a difference to someone’s life by sharing your industry knowledge, experience and stories is incredibly exciting and rewarding. We work passionately to prepare our students’ to be ‘work ready, world ready’ for an industry we love . . . and you can be a part of this

title: Healthcare Data Scientist (Remote, International)
description:
You'll work on customer projects, where hospitals, payers and pharma companies use our software on their own data. Your work includes:
• Model training: fine-tune LLM and NLP models for entity extraction, assertion status and relation extraction on clinical notes, using Spark NLP for Healthcare and open-source Python libraries.
• Extraction pipelines: pull structured facts from clinical notes, pathology and radiology reports, scanned PDFs and DICOM images, and remove PHI from them.
• Data harmonization: map what you extract to the OMOP common data model, FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC) to build each patient's journey.
• Validation: test models for bias, overfitting and drift before and after they go live.
• Customer work: scope problems with customer data teams, explain results to clinicians and engineers, and write up what you built.
## Requirements: 5+ industry years on clinical data
## You need all of these:
• At least 5 years as a hands-on data scientist or ML engineer in industry, delivering projects that went into production. Academic work alone, or apps built only by calling an LLM API, isn't enough.
• Proven work on clinical data: clinical notes, pathology or radiology reports, medical images, EHR records, or OMOP and FHIR datasets. Experience limited to claims or billing data doesn't qualify.
• Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain / LangSmith, Spark NLP, or related open-source libraries.
• Proven working knowledge of current software development tools such as GitHub, Docker, AWS / Azure, Claude Code / Codex.
• Clear written and spoken English, since you'll present to customer teams every week.
PhD or MD and Healthcare AI Industry Experience Preferred
These put your application near the top of the pile:
• A PhD in computer science, biomedical informatics, biostatistics or a related field, or an MD, plus industry experience after it.
• Work at a clinical NLP or healthcare AI company, a cloud healthcare AI service, or the data science team of a health system, payer or pharma company.
• Hands-on use of Spark NLP, Healthcare NLP or our Medical LLM.
• Peer-reviewed papers or shared-task results in clinical NLP or medical imaging, for example at AMIA, ACL, NAACL or EMNLP.
• De-identification, OMOP ETL, or work with research clinical datasets such as MIMIC.
## Long-term freelance contract worldwide
You'll work remotely as an independent contractor on a long-term contract of 30 to 40 hours a week. This isn't a full-time employment role, and we contract with individuals only, not agencies or teams. You can apply from any country except those where US sanctions or our own policy prevent us from contracting.
John Snow Labs is profitable and has never taken venture or debt financing, so we hire for multi-year work.
Apply yourself: we don't review submissions from recruiters or agencies. Your cover letter should include the words "John Snow Labs", the country you live in now, one clinical data project you delivered (the dataset, your role, the model or method, the result), and links to your GitHub or papers. Applications without these are hard for us to assess, so we may not reply to them.
John Snow Labs is looking for senior healthcare data scientists to build clinical LLM and NLP pipelines for more than 500 enterprise customers in healthcare and life sciences. This is a remote contract of at least 30 hours a week, open to individuals in most countries.
You'll join a team that works across 28 countries, where 33% of members hold a PhD or MD and 75% hold at least a master's degree. Our software includes Healthcare NLP, Medical LLM, visual language models, multimodal de-identification, OMOP harmonization, and the Patient Journey Intelligence platform.
John Snow Labs has won 50+ industry awards, including Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Customer Value Leadership Award for Healthcare Large Language Models, and was ranked first among 190+ companies by MarketsandMarkets for NLP in Healthcare and Life Sciences.

You'll design and ship LLM features that real people use every day: chat assistants, knowledge search, safety checks, and the tests that prove a model is good enough before it goes live. Your first project is an AI product in healthcare, a regulated space where safety, privacy and data residency really matter. After that, you'll lead similar AI projects for other clients. You'll choose models based on real test results, review AI code from other developers, and explain your choices to clients who are not technical. This is a full-time, in-house role on the Bolder Apps team, open to people based in the countries listed in this post. If you've taken LLM features past the prototype stage and into production, and you care as much about safety and evaluation as about clever prompts, we want to talk.
## About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.
## Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.
There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.
If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.
## Responsibilities
• Own the AI design on client projects: chat flows, knowledge search, safety checks, model choice and testing
• Build retrieval (RAG) pipelines with embeddings, hybrid search and reranking on PostgreSQL with pgvector
• Design prompts, context and multi-step chat flows, including agents, tool use and streaming replies
• Work with open-weight models such as Qwen, Llama and Gemma, served through LiteLLM or another OpenAI-compatible gateway and Azure AI Foundry
• Build evaluation: test sets, automated quality checks, and side-by-side model comparisons on quality, speed and cost
• Put safety in from day one: guardrails, safety classifiers, content moderation and protection against prompt injection
• Pick the right model from test results and explain the choice clearly to a non-technical client
• Review AI code from other developers and set the standard for how we build with LLMs
• Join client technical calls and answer their AI questions directly
## Nice to have
• Arabic speaker, or experience building LLM products in Arabic or other non-English languages (a big plus)
• NestJS experience
• Fine-tuning with LoRA or QLoRA, and self-hosting models on GPUs (for example vLLM)
• Speech to text, text to speech or voice AI
• Healthcare, mental health or other regulated data, including data residency rules
• Azure, especially Azure AI Foundry
## Requirements
• 4+ years in software engineering or ML, with at least 2 years building LLM applications that real users use. Prototypes and demos alone don't count
• Strong Python
• Hands-on RAG in production: embeddings, hybrid search, reranking and vector databases
• Prompt and context engineering, plus multi-step chat flows (orchestration, agents) with streaming replies
• Real evaluation work. You've built test sets and automated quality checks and used them to compare models on quality, speed and cost
• AI safety experience: guardrails, safety classifiers, content moderation and prompt-injection protection
• Comfortable working in a TypeScript / Node.js codebase alongside the backend team
• You can explain a model choice and its trade-offs to a non-technical client in plain words
• Good spoken and written English. You'll write design docs and join client technical calls
• AI-augmented workflow. You use AI tools every day in your own engineering work
## Benefits
• Full-time, in-house role on the Bolder Apps team
• Own the AI design on real products in a regulated space, not toy demos
• Steady pipeline of AI projects after the first one
• Real ownership over model choice and architecture, with no rigid playbook
• Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome
• A peer network of engineers, designers and PMs working on overlapping projects

title: Performance Marketer (m/w/d) - Meta Ads × AI × Creative Strategy | E-Commerce, O
description:
Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien. Wir suchen jemanden, der alle drei verbindet.
Erstens: Performance. Du führst Meta-Ads-Accounts für hochpreisigen E-Commerce - Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, lange Kaufentscheidungen, komplexe Customer Journeys. Du steuerst nach Geschäftszahlen (CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER), nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Wenn du verstehst, warum das richtig sein kann, bist du hier richtig.
Zweitens: AI - richtig eingesetzt. Wir sind eine AI-native Agentur. Das heißt bei uns: eigene MCP-Anbindung an die Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits und Anomalie-Erkennung, selbstgebaute Skills für Angle-Entwicklung und Skript-Bau. Diese Werkzeuge sollst du nicht bedienen wie ein Formular, sondern führen wie ein Instrument: AI übernimmt das Wie (Analysen strukturieren, Varianten bauen, Daten durchkämmen), die Hypothese - das Was - bleibt deine. Wer jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, produziert denselben Output, den jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell auch bekommt. Beides scheidet aus.
Drittens: Creative Strategy. Bei High-AOV entscheidet das Creative, nicht der Kampagnen-Setup-Trick. Du musst keine Creatives produzieren, aber du musst sie lesen können: Warum gewinnt dieser Winner? Welches Segment, welche Kaufhürde, welcher Beweis fehlt im Funnel? Du entwickelst mit dem Creative-Team Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → Angle), verstehst, warum ein kalter Markt andere Hooks braucht als ein heißer, und liest Creative-Performance jenseits von Hook Rate und Thumbstop.
Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio und dem Anspruch, in unserer Nische die Beste in Deutschland zu sein. Unsere Kunden kaufen Urteilsvermögen, kein Button-Pushing: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und nicht nur Anzeigen ins System tippen.
## Aufgaben
• Du führst Accounts end-to-end: Audit → Hypothese → Test-Plan → Skalierung → Reporting.
• Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers und inkrementellen KPIs; du verstehst warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht.
• Du nutzt unseren AI-Stack als Standard-Werkzeug. Account-Audits, Breakdown-Analysen und Anomalie-Erkennung laufen AI-gestützt; du lieferst die Fragestellung, prüfst den Output und triffst die Entscheidung.
• Du dekodierst Creative-Performance: Du erkennst, warum ein Winner gewinnt (Hook, Mechanismus, Einwandbehandlung, Proof), und übersetzt das in die nächste Test-Hypothese.
• Du bringst eigene Angle- und Set-Piece-Hypothesen in die Creative-Planung ein: Welches Segment ist unterversorgt, welche Kaufhürde unbeantwortet, welches Stück Customer Journey fehlt.
• Du sagst Kunden die harte Wahrheit, wenn der Bottleneck das Offer, die Landingpage oder das Produkt ist und nicht die Ads. Und du lieferst dazu immer einen Alternativweg.
## Qualifikation
## Dein Profil:
• Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Führen von Meta-Ads-Accounts mit relevantem Budget
• Du arbeitest täglich und tief mit AI: eigene Prompts und Workflows, Erfahrung mit LLM-gestützter Analyse. Du kannst konkret zeigen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
• Du kannst eine fremde Winning-Ad auseinandernehmen und erklären, warum sie funktioniert. Nicht "gutes Video", sondern Zielgruppe, Mechanismus, Beweisführung.
• Du kennst die Grundlogik von Awareness- und Sophistication-Stufen (Schwartz) oder Vergleichbares aus der Praxis: verschiedene Bewusstseinsstufen brauchen verschiedene Botschaften.
• Du denkst in Geschäftszahlen und verstehst ROAS ≠ Deckungsbeitrag
• Du hast die Geduld für lange Journeys, die Disziplin, einem System zu folgen, und bist konfrontationsfähig gegenüber Kunden.
## Benefits
• Eine Rolle am Schnittpunkt von Performance, AI und Creative - mit Werkzeugen, die wir selbst bauen statt einkaufen.
• Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
• Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.
• Kompetitiver Gehalt basierend auf deinem Erfahrungslevel
• Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht.
• Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work sind bei uns keine Fremdwörter.
• Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten.
• Nette, professionelle und sorgfältig ausgesuchte Kunden - die dein Leben definitiv NICHT zur Hölle machen. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden auf Augenhöhe.
## So läuft die Bewerbung:
• Kurzbewerbung - Im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: Ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon.
• 2 x Gespräche - 1x mit Geschäftsführer & 1x mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung.
• Eine kompakte Probearbeit an einem realen Szenario. AI-Einsatz ist dabei ausdrücklich erlaubt und erwünscht - uns interessiert, wo du sie einsetzt und wo bewusst nicht.
Du erkennst dich wieder? Dann bewirb dich.

title: AI Research Engineer (Multi-Modal Agents)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
## Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
## But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
## Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
## Are you ready to be part of the future?
## About the job
As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.
You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.
You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.
## Responsibilities
Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.
Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.
Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.
Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.
Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.
Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.
Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.
Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.
## Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience.
Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks.
Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang).
Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation.
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.
When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.
As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.
Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing
Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents
Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost
A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans
## What You'll Do
## CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)
Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers
Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume

Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent
Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages
Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements

Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar
Lightly manage the existing reviews setup
## AI Content & Sales Enablement
Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI
Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats
Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out
## Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads
Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns
Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools
Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel
## Qualifications
## Required Qualifications
AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself
3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term
Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)
Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot
GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership
SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress
Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities
Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva
Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them
Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook
C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours
## Preferred Qualifications
Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans
Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel
## Direct mail campaign experience
Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations
Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth
Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations

Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender
Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner
Visible, measurable impact on company growth

title: Network Solution Architekt, Cloud & AI (m/w/d)
description:
## Über uns:
Wir sind Yorizon:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Lösungen setzen wir auf digitale Souveränität. Wir sind eine Tochter von HOCHTIEF und bauen eine europäische Cloud-Plattform nach europäischen Sicherheitsstandards, die vollständig in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren läuft.
Open Source ist unsere DNA: Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.
Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power:Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.
## Dein Wirkungsbereich:
Als Netzwerkarchitekt (m/w/d) im Team Data Center Operations entwirfst Du das Netzwerk unserer Cloud. Es reicht vom Spine-Leaf-Fabric über Multi-Tenant-Netze in OpenStack und Kubernetes bis zu GPU-Clustern für AI-Workloads, und das über mehrere Rechenzentrumsstandorte hinweg. Du legst fest, wie unser Netz heute und in drei Jahren aussieht, und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Plattform- und Operations-Teams zusammen.
## Deine Rolle:
Architektur & Design:Du entwirfst skalierbare, hochverfügbare Netzwerkarchitekturen für unsere Multi-Datacenter-Umgebung auf Basis von OpenStack und Kubernetes.
Multi-Tenancy:Du gestaltest mandantenfähige Netzwerke mit Neutron/OVN sowie Container-Networking mit CNI-Plugins wie Cilium oder Calico.
High-Performance-Netzwerke für AI:Du planst Netzwerktopologien für GPU-Cluster mit RoCE, InfiniBand und lossless Ethernet und optimierst sie für verteiltes Training und latenzkritische Anwendungen.
Multi-DC-Strategie: Du verantwortest Inter-DC-Connectivity, Geo-Redundanz, Failover-Szenarien sowie Disaster-Recovery- und Business-Continuity-Konzepte.
Performance & Betrieb: Du sorgst für Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit des Netzes, unter anderem durch Load-Balancing, Traffic-Engineering, QoS und Kapazitätsplanung.
Technologieauswahl: Du bewertest neue Netzwerktechnologien und Standards und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen, gerne auch für offene Lösungen wie SONiC.
Wissen teilen:Du erstellst Architekturdiagramme, Standards und Best-Practice-Leitfäden, berätst Entwicklungs- und Operations-Teams und gestaltest Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen mit.
## Das bringst Du mit:
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur und Betrieb von Netzwerken in Rechenzentren. Du hast physische DC-Infrastruktur selbst geplant und betrieben, nicht nur Cloud-Netze bei Hyperscalern konfiguriert. Ob Du dafür ein Informatikstudium oder einen anderen Weg gegangen bist, ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst.
• Fundiertes Know-how in modernen DC-Architekturen (Spine-Leaf/CLOS) und Routing mit BGP und EVPN-VXLAN
• Erfahrung mit Netzwerkvirtualisierung in OpenStack (Neutron, OVN/OVS) und/oder Kubernetes (CNI, Network Policies, Ingress)
• Praxis mit Automatisierung und Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps
• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Netzwerkthemen verständlich zu erklären und Entscheidungen sauber zu dokumentieren
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zu unseren Rechenzentrumsstandorten
## Nice to have:
• Erfahrung mit GPU-Netzwerken: RDMA/RoCE, InfiniBand, GPUDirect, NVLink/NVSwitch
Verständnis für die Netzwerkanforderungen von verteiltem AI-Training (NCCL, MPI, All-Reduce)
• Erfahrung mit SONiC, P4 oder anderen SDN-Ansätzen
• Erfahrung mit 100G/400G Ethernet und optischen Netzen
• Monitoring mit Prometheus, Grafana oder ELK
• Zertifizierungen wie CCIE, CKA oder NVIDIA NCP, die für uns aber kein Muss sind
## Unser Angebot:
Teamspirit:Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden Teams mit echter Du-Kultur. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, deine Talente aktiv einzubringen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
Karrierechancen: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Nutze die vielfältigen Aufstiegschancen in einem expandierenden Umfeld und profitiere von unseren spannenden internationalen Perspektiven.
Remote first:Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Arbeite 100 % remote aus Deutschland oder Österreich oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Augsburg oder Wien.
Deine Entwicklung:Wir investieren in dich. Mit einem eigenen Weiterbildungsbudget entscheidest du selbst, welche fachlichen oder persönlichen Skills du als Nächstes vertiefen möchtest.
Equipment: Damit du Bestleistungen bringen kannst, bekommst du das passende Werkzeug. Wähle frei zwischen modernsten Apple- oder Windows-Geräten.
Mobilität:Wir bezuschussen dein Deutschlandticket, damit du entspannt und nachhaltig unterwegs bist.
Wellbeing:Mit Wellpass nutzt du tausende Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbäder, Yoga- und Wellnessangebote in ganz Deutschland, ganz flexibel nach deinem Geschmack.
Zeit für dich:Freu dich auf 30 Urlaubstage. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns zusätzlich komplett frei.
Purpose: Für dein ehrenamtliches Engagement bekommst du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag.

title: Data Scientist - Core Analytics
description:
Ripjar builds software and data products that help our customers combat serious financial crime. Our technology identifies criminal activity such as money laundering and terrorist financing, and helps customers enforce sanctions at scale.
Data is at the heart of everything we do. Much of it is multilingual text: an archive of over 10 billion news articles in 150+ languages, going back more than 30 years, alongside government sanctions, watchlist data and ownership data on 250 million organisations from corporate registries worldwide.
Working at this scale means our problems are as much computational as statistical. Comparing hundreds of millions of entities, or running models over billions of documents, is intractable without the right algorithms, so careful thinking about complexity and efficient implementation is part of the job.
## Data Science Team
Our data science team builds and maintains the models behind Ripjar’s screening product. Much of the work is NLP, including named entity recognition, risk classification, entity resolution, duplicate detection, summarisation and geolocation, and we're increasingly using LLMs to push this further.
The team sits within Engineering and works in short cycles, shipping improvements regularly and measuring their impact. Because our customers operate in heavily regulated environments, our models face a high level of scrutiny, so every change needs to be well tested, explainable and backed by evidence.
This is a great time to join a growing team of talented technologists and data scientists building products that change how financial crime is detected and prevented. We're keen to hear from experienced data scientists at a range of levels, and the scope of the role will reflect what you bring.
## What you'll be doing:
We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist who is motivated to solve customer problems and enjoys owning them end to end, from:
• Framing the problem and exploring the data
• Building and evaluating models
• Deploying, scaling and maintaining the solution in production
You will work with language models, machine learning tools and large-scale distributed clusters.
This role suits a data scientist with a strength in NLP and a genuine interest in computing: someone who thinks about algorithmic complexity, memory and throughput as naturally as model accuracy. You'll enjoy shipping a model that adds real value quickly and iterating on it based on real-world feedback.
Ripjar equips staff with the very best AI tooling to help them work effectively via judicious review.
Some recent work Ripjar’s data scientists have been involved in:
• Entity resolution across tens of millions of news articles, at a scale where naive pairwise comparison is intractable.
• Using LLMs to summarise news articles linking an entity to financial crime (or other similar risks), with LLM judges to monitor performance.
• Using LLMs to run automated quality assurance on our data outputs at scale.
## Key Tasks:
• Analyse large datasets using Ripjar’s distributed data processing infrastructure to identify patterns and inform new analytics and models.
• Develop and evaluate machine learning models, including LLM-based approaches, to enhance Ripjar’s products.
• Design algorithms and pipelines that stay tractable at scale, making sensible trade-offs between accuracy, latency and compute cost.
• Work with Data Engineers and the wider engineering team to integrate models into our products and pipelines, then own their performance, efficiency and maintenance in production.
• Design statistical tests, evaluate results, and document models and methodologies to the standard our regulated customers expect.
• Work with Product and, from time to time, directly with customers to understand their needs, explain analytics, models and test results, and help resolve questions about how our models behave in practice.
## Requirements
• Experience delivering data science solutions end to end, from prototype to production, including testing, deployment and long-term maintenance.
• Strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures and computational complexity, and how to apply them to make large-scale problems tractable.
• Proficiency in Python and writing production-quality, performant code, particularly with machine learning and data science libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, numpy and scipy.
• Proficiency using Natural Language Processing techniques to solve problems, ideally including Large Language Models.
• Working knowledge of statistics.
• Experience working with large-scale data processing systems such as Spark and Hadoop.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Keen to use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up development and experimentation.
• A habit of keeping up to date with developments in AI, including ML, NLP and LLMs, and judging which new techniques and tools are worth applying to real problems.
• Cloud-based experience is desirable.
• Experience using or implementing MLOps approaches is desirable.
## Benefits
## Why we think you’ll enjoy it here:
• Competitive base salary DOE
• 25 days annual leave + birthdays off, rising to 30 days after 5 years of service
• Christmas shutdown
• Fully remote or office based working
• 35 hour working week
• Private Family Healthcare
• Life Assurance
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Salary sacrifice pension scheme
• Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
• There is a well-stocked pantry with food, snacks and drinks when in the office

title: Healthcare Data Scientist (Remote, International)
description:
You'll work on customer projects, where hospitals, payers and pharma companies use our software on their own data. Your work includes:
• Model training: fine-tune LLM and NLP models for entity extraction, assertion status and relation extraction on clinical notes, using Spark NLP for Healthcare and open-source Python libraries.
• Extraction pipelines: pull structured facts from clinical notes, pathology and radiology reports, scanned PDFs and DICOM images, and remove PHI from them.
• Data harmonization: map what you extract to the OMOP common data model, FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC) to build each patient's journey.
• Validation: test models for bias, overfitting and drift before and after they go live.
• Customer work: scope problems with customer data teams, explain results to clinicians and engineers, and write up what you built.
## Requirements: 5+ industry years on clinical data
## You need all of these:
• At least 5 years as a hands-on data scientist or ML engineer in industry, delivering projects that went into production. Academic work alone, or apps built only by calling an LLM API, isn't enough.
• Proven work on clinical data: clinical notes, pathology or radiology reports, medical images, EHR records, or OMOP and FHIR datasets. Experience limited to claims or billing data doesn't qualify.
• Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain / LangSmith, Spark NLP, or related open-source libraries.
• Proven working knowledge of current software development tools such as GitHub, Docker, AWS / Azure, Claude Code / Codex.
• Clear written and spoken English, since you'll present to customer teams every week.
PhD or MD and Healthcare AI Industry Experience Preferred
These put your application near the top of the pile:
• A PhD in computer science, biomedical informatics, biostatistics or a related field, or an MD, plus industry experience after it.
• Work at a clinical NLP or healthcare AI company, a cloud healthcare AI service, or the data science team of a health system, payer or pharma company.
• Hands-on use of Spark NLP, Healthcare NLP or our Medical LLM.
• Peer-reviewed papers or shared-task results in clinical NLP or medical imaging, for example at AMIA, ACL, NAACL or EMNLP.
• De-identification, OMOP ETL, or work with research clinical datasets such as MIMIC.
## Long-term freelance contract worldwide
You'll work remotely as an independent contractor on a long-term contract of 30 to 40 hours a week. This isn't a full-time employment role, and we contract with individuals only, not agencies or teams. You can apply from any country except those where US sanctions or our own policy prevent us from contracting.
John Snow Labs is profitable and has never taken venture or debt financing, so we hire for multi-year work.
Apply yourself: we don't review submissions from recruiters or agencies. Your cover letter should include the words "John Snow Labs", the country you live in now, one clinical data project you delivered (the dataset, your role, the model or method, the result), and links to your GitHub or papers. Applications without these are hard for us to assess, so we may not reply to them.
John Snow Labs is looking for senior healthcare data scientists to build clinical LLM and NLP pipelines for more than 500 enterprise customers in healthcare and life sciences. This is a remote contract of at least 30 hours a week, open to individuals in most countries.
You'll join a team that works across 28 countries, where 33% of members hold a PhD or MD and 75% hold at least a master's degree. Our software includes Healthcare NLP, Medical LLM, visual language models, multimodal de-identification, OMOP harmonization, and the Patient Journey Intelligence platform.
John Snow Labs has won 50+ industry awards, including Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Customer Value Leadership Award for Healthcare Large Language Models, and was ranked first among 190+ companies by MarketsandMarkets for NLP in Healthcare and Life Sciences.

title: Junior Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Title: Junior Data Analytics Engineer
## Department: Data, Operations, & Finance
Reports to: Manager of Data Analytics Engineering
## Location: Remote
## Effective Date: TBD
ABOUT THE DC PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL BOARD (DC PCSB)
Every day, we’re doing the work to ensure that 44,000+ public charter school students, families, and communities receive a quality education that makes them feel valued and prepared for lifelong learning, fulfilling careers, and economic security. DC PCSB is an independent agency of the District of Columbia government. Our mission, vision, values, and work are rooted in the principle of ensuring that every DC student has access to a quality education.
## ABOUT THE ROLE
The Data Team collects, maintains, stores, analyzes, reports on, and secures school-related data. We build and maintain analytics products, including data exports, analytic reports, a school-facing data portal, a governed data warehouse, and data pipelines. Our partners include agency staff and leadership, the Board, charter school leaders, and the public.
As a Junior Data Analytics Engineer, you will help build and maintain data products that support charter school oversight and informed decision-making. You will work on a team of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers and report to the Manager of Data Analytics Engineering. This early-career position is designed for someone with zero to two years of relevant experience.
You will contribute through clearly defined assignments and assist more experienced Analytics Engineers across the team with complex work by completing components of data preparation, database maintenance, analysis, and reporting under their guidance and review. You are expected to take ownership of your assigned work, actively seek advice when needed, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills and deliver reliable results. As your skills develop, you will take on increasingly complex work with greater independence.
You will participate in the team's planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives, contribute to the Team Handbook, and follow established data governance and quality practices.
## Core Responsibilities
• Write and maintain SQL queries to retrieve, join, filter, and summarize data, with guidance and review from more experienced engineers.
• Make defined updates to database records and implement or maintain basic tables within existing data models, following documented conventions and checking results through established review and validation procedures.
• Clean, combine, and transform structured datasets in Python, including joins, filtering, and aggregation, under the guidance of more experienced engineers.
• Create and maintain Quarto reports and data visualizations that communicate findings clearly, applying basic data storytelling and accessibility principles with guidance.
• Execute existing ETL and Airflow workflows, check logs and outputs, troubleshoot basic failures, and seek support for problems beyond your current knowledge.
• Apply basic descriptive and inferential statistics to defined analytical questions with guidance, and document methods, assumptions, and limitations.
• Use Git-based workflows to submit well-documented code for review, participate in merge request reviews at an appropriate level, and add or update validation checks and tests with guidance.
• Persist through technical challenges by investigating problems, proactively seeking advice from more senior Analytics Engineers, and applying their guidance to move work forward. Clearly communicate what you have tried, where you need help, and blockers that could affect delivery commitments.
• Collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues to clarify assigned tasks and explain straightforward data outputs and calculations in plain language.
• Support LEA partners with routine data submission questions through the team's support platform, following documented procedures and escalating questions when needed.
• Participate in planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives; communicate progress and blockers; and contribute useful documentation to the Team Handbook.
• Follow established data governance, confidentiality, and quality practices, and demonstrate DC PCSB's values and REDI commitments in your work and collaboration.
## Competencies and Qualifications
Candidates should generally have at least two (2) years of professional experience applying statistical methods, machine learning, causal inference, or related data science techniques to real-world problems. Relevant undergraduate and graduate-level research may substitute for up to two years of professional experience.
• Data Preparation and Transformation in Python: Demonstrated ability to clean, combine, and transform structured datasets in Python using Pandas or similar libraries, including joins, filtering, and aggregation, with guidance.
• Data Modeling & Data Mart Stewardship: Demonstrated ability to implement and maintain basic SQL tables within an existing data model, following documented conventions for naming, keys, and schema organization.
• SQL and Query Optimization: Demonstrated ability to write correct SQL queries for data retrieval and aggregation, with awareness of basic performance practices such as limiting results and understanding indexes.
• Data Visualization and Reporting: Demonstrated ability to create clear static or scripted visualizations and reports in Quarto with guidance, applying basic data storytelling and accessibility principles.
• Analytics Workflow Automation: Demonstrated ability to execute existing ETL or Airflow tasks, understand orchestration and logging, and troubleshoot basic failures with guidance.
• Statistical and Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to apply basic descriptive and inferential statistics, including means, correlations, and simple regressions, to structured datasets with guidance.
• Code Quality and Version Control: Demonstrated ability to use Git-based workflows to submit changes for review and maintain well-documented code.
• Partner Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, produce clear documentation, and explain straightforward methods, assumptions, and results in plain language with guidance.
• Demonstrated persistence in solving problems, proactively seeking and applying advice from more experienced Analytics Engineers, and communicating uncertainty and blockers promptly.
• Ability to organize assigned work and collaborate respectfully with colleagues.
• Alignment with DC PCSB's mission, vision and core values.
## Compensation and Benefits
Salary is competitive and commensurate with prior experience in a similar role. DC PCSB offers a comprehensive benefits plan covering 100% of the employee’s insurance premium. If you’re employed by a government or not-for-profit organization, you might be eligible for the PSLF Program. Please visit the studentaid.gov website for eligibility details and requirements. DC PCSB offers a generous telecommuting policy.
To foster fair compensation practices within our organization, there is a non-negotiation policy built into our compensation system. The salary for this role is $80,000-$90,000.
DC PCSB is an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a unified workplace. We are committed to ensuring all employees feel valued and respected. We recognize that multiple perspectives and experiences contribute to a strong and effective team, enhancing our ability to fulfill our mission.
## To Apply
Please submit a cover letter of no more than 500 words addressing the following:
Describe a specific situation you have encountered in school, work, volunteering, or everyday life where better information could help a public agency or community organization serve people more effectively.
• What problem did you notice, and who did it affect?
• How could data, a report, or a simple tool help? What would someone be able to understand or do differently?
• What would you need to learn from the people affected before deciding what to build?
• How does this example connect to your interest in the Junior Data Analytics Engineer role at DC PCSB?
You do not need to have solved the problem or built a tool. We are interested in your observations, reasoning, and curiosity. Be specific about the situation and explain your thinking in plain language; technical terminology is unnecessary.
Your response should reflect your own judgment and writing. Strong responses will demonstrate an understanding of this role, attention to the people who would use or be affected by your work, and a thoughtful connection between data and public service. The phrase triggers additional review because the applicant apparently submitted text containing an irrelevant hidden instruction.
The review of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. DC PCSB is not enrolled in E-Verify and does not sponsor individuals for work visas.

Education

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.
