title: Data Analyst
description:
## About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with exciting career opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. We work with a diverse range of clients, including startups, digital agencies, and technology companies operating in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and AI.
Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly within our clients' businesses, where you are hired as an in-house team member, working alongside their teams and contributing to their success.
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
## Job Summary
We’re looking for a highly analytical and technically skilled Business Intelligence Analyst to own reporting, analytics, and business insight generation across a European operation. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, CRM analytics, SQL, and business intelligence reporting. You’ll act as the analytical engine of the business, helping leaders make smarter, data-led decisions through dashboards, forecasting, and strategic insights.
This role goes beyond building reports. You will proactively identify trends, opportunities, and risks while becoming a trusted partner to leadership teams. Ideal candidates have experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting automation, and executive stakeholder engagement.
## Key Responsibilities
• Reporting & Dashboard Development
• Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions to track key business metrics.
• Manage the reporting process from gathering requirements through implementation and ongoing maintenance.
• Ensure reporting accuracy, data consistency, performance, and timely updates.
• Identify opportunities to improve existing reports and reporting processes.
• Data Management & Integration
• Develop and maintain data pipelines to collect, process, and organise data from multiple sources.
• Build and maintain data models to support accurate and efficient reporting.
• Ensure data quality, integrity, consistency, and accessibility across systems.
• Collaborate with technical teams to improve data infrastructure and integrations.
• Business Systems & Data Analysis
• Extract, integrate, and analyse data from various business systems, including CRM and ERP platforms.
• Develop reports and dashboards to monitor sales, customer activity, financial performance, and operational metrics.
• Identify and resolve data discrepancies to maintain reliable reporting.
• Consolidate information from different sources to provide a comprehensive view of business performance.
• Business Insights & Analysis
• Analyse business performance, trends, and patterns to identify opportunities and potential risks.
• Prepare regular analytical reports and present findings to relevant stakeholders.
• Develop forecasts, trend analyses, and data models to support business planning.
• Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that support decision-making.
• Stakeholder Collaboration
• Work closely with teams across different business functions to understand their reporting and analytical needs.
• Translate business requirements into practical data solutions.
• Support stakeholders in interpreting data and using reporting tools effectively.
• Maintain clear documentation of reporting processes, KPIs, data models, and analytical standards.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or a related field.
• Strong proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling and dashboard development.
• Hands-on experience with data platforms and tools such as Microsoft Fabric.
• Experience working with CRM and ERP systems, including data analysis and reporting.
• Strong SQL skills, including querying, data manipulation, and transformation.
• Ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
• Good understanding of business operations and performance metrics.
• Experience working with data across multiple departments, regions, or markets.
• Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and cloud-based data services.
• Familiarity with forecasting, predictive analytics, and trend analysis.
• Experience with data visualisation and reporting automation.
• Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Power Automate.
## Benefits
## Requirements & Qualifications
💰 Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and technical skills.
🌍 Remote-first work environment offering flexibility.
📊 Opportunity to work with modern technologies.
🚀 Be part of a growing organisation with a strong focus on data and analytics transformation.
📈 Take on a visible role with the opportunity to influence business performance and strategic decisions.
🎯 Help shape reporting processes and establish yourself as a key analytical partner to the business.
📚 Access to ongoing learning, professional development, and career growth opportunities.

title: Software Engineer - Edge & Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
## 1KOMMA5°
At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.
By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.
## Your mission
• Full-Stack Development (Edge to Cloud): You develop the core components for our energy management system Heartbeat AI Enterprise – both locally on our IoT gateways (Edge) and scalably in our cloud-native backend architecture
• Gateway Programming (Go & Lua): You write high-performance code for our edge controllers. With Golang, you build robust system services and communication layers; with Lua, you create lightweight, dynamically adaptable control scripts and protocol drivers for inverters, BESS, and HVAC systems
• Cloud Services & Microservices: You design and program scalable microservices in Go within the cloud backend to process time-series data, telemetry, and manage fleet operations across hundreds of customer sites
• Interfaces & Protocols: You implement communication protocols for the IoT ecosystem (MQTT, REST/gRPC) as well as for local equipment communication (Modbus TCP/RTU)
• VPP & Trading Integration: You enable seamless data flow between local systems (meter readings, flexibilities) and our Virtual Power Plant for automated control based on spot market prices
• Agile Collaboration: You work closely in a cross-functional team with system architects, PLC developers, and product management to swiftly bring new commercial energy management features to the platform
## Your profile
• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable qualification, or sound professional experience in professional software development
• Strong programming skills in Golang (Go) (ideally in a cloud and microservices context) as well as practical experience in the Lua scripting language (e.g., for embedded / edge applications)
• Solid understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
• Experience in developing IoT solutions or edge computing applications, preferably on Linux-based systems (e.g., Raspberry Pi, industrial PCs)
• Confident handling of common network and IoT protocols (such as MQTT, REST) and ideally experience with industrial communication (Modbus)
• A structured, solution-oriented mindset and the motivation to actively contribute to building Europe's largest decentralized Virtual Power Plant
• Business-fluent German and English skills, both written and spoken
## Benefits
• You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
• With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
• Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
• You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
• You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
• You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
• Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
• Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
• Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: SOX AI Specialist (Contractor)
description:
## About us
Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world’s largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.
We’re headquartered in San Francisco, California, and backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and others.
## About the Engagement
We are seeking an experienced SOX and internal controls practitioner for a paid, short-term contract engagement. This is not a full-time role (at this time).
Over an initial engagement of 8–12 weeks, with the potential to extend, you will work directly with a small, cross-functional group of subject-matter experts, AI engineers, and product partners. You’ll help translate real-world SOX testing judgment into reliable, AI-assisted workflows. This is not a traditional client-delivery audit or attestation role. Your focus will be on prompting and refining AI agents to execute control testing and partnering closely with AI engineers to identify new engineering capabilities to enable better control testing.
Engagement type: Direct contractor
Initial term: 8–12 weeks, with potential to extend
Start date: Immediate
Time commitment: Approximately 40 hours per week
Target rate: $60–$80 per hour, based on experience, with flexibility for an exceptional fit.
## What You’ll Do
Partner closely with engineering, product, and design teams to translate real-world SOX testing processes into scalable product capabilities.
Co-develop AI agents with AI engineers to execute detailed SOX testing by translating SOX testing methodology into specific guidance, decision rules, and examples.
Work hands-on with AI agents: write and refine prompts, run controls and evidence through testing workflows, evaluate outputs, and document failure modes.
Analyze risk and control matrices and test plans to identify opportunities for improved agentic testing.
Develop stress-test scenarios, review and assess AI agent performance, and create detailed error analyses and evaluation criteria.
## What We’re Looking For
At least four years of hands-on control testing experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or internal controls, with direct responsibility for control design and testing.
Broad experience across a range of control types, industries, and firms, with clear expertise in business process control testing.
The ability to consistently explain why a test step, exception, or conclusion passes or fails and to turn that reasoning into clear evaluation criteria.
Strong written reasoning: you can explain workflows and decisions step by step and turn professional judgment into clear rules, edge cases, and review criteria.
A high degree of comfort and hands-on experience using AI tools, writing prompts, and working with agentic harnesses.
Comfort operating in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, and changing your approach when the evidence does not support it.
Availability for the expected time commitment during the initial engagement.
## What We’d Love to See
Experience at the senior or manager level reviewing SOX workpapers or coaching testers.
A CPA, CIA, or similar relevant credential.
Experience across multiple companies, clients, industries, or control environments.
Familiarity with both business process controls and ITGCs.
Demonstrated interest or experience in creating AI workflows or tools of any kind.

title: Software Engineer
description:
At Quest Analytics®, we build technology that helps health plans navigate some of the most complex challenges in healthcare. We’re searching for a Software Engineer to help us build and scale our platform.
You’ll own the features you build, from first requirements conversation through deployment, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers. Your input on design and architecture will carry real weight, and the decisions you help make will shape our current offerings, and new product lines as we grow.
Our engineering teams value high-quality code, open collaboration, and creative problem solving. We review each other’s work with constructive feedback, communicate early about blockers and risks, and take ownership of our results. We also embrace new technology, including AI-powered tools, to improve both the quality and the speed of what we deliver, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how our teams use them.
## What you'll do
Take part in the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers to turn requirements into working software.
Own your project timelines and deliverables, flag blockers and risks early so your team can help.
Contribute to the design and architecture of new and existing products and features.
Write clean, efficient, maintainable code built for performance and scalability.
Give constructive feedback in code reviews and hold your work to team coding standards.
Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to improve the quality and speed of development and help shape how the team adopts them.
Make day-to-day technical decisions within established patterns, and bring larger choices, like major frameworks or design patterns, to your manager.
Handle confidential information with care, especially protected health information (PHI), and follow Quest Analytics HIPAA Privacy and Security Practices.
Join training and mentoring programs, as a learner or as a guide.
## What you'll need
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.
Three to five years of backend development with Microsoft’s .NET Framework and C# at a commercial SaaS company, ideally working with large data sets.
Proficiency in SQL Server and in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs.
Snowflake, Databricks, or general data platform experience for large data processing.
Experience building on Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus, plus familiarity with Blob Storage or AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SNS, or SQS.
Experience with React or a comparable modern JavaScript framework for front-end work.
Familiarity with unit testing (XUnit preferred) and SOLID principles.
Source control experience with Git.
Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach to your work.
Experience multiplying your output with AI development tools.

title: Software Engineer
description:
## Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
## Vonage Communications APIs:
As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. ## Internship, 3 months
Location: Berlin (hybrid)

Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point.
Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them.
In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.
## What you'll do.
You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.
Build and improve across the whole stack, from the research dashboard to the data layer to LLM output handling, every change shipped with a test
Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights
Extend how we collect data: interview agents, surveys, document ingestion
Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships

An interest in philosophy, sociology, anthropology, psychology, politics or behavioural sciences in general

Ownership of real problems from week one, and a piece of the architecture you can name on your CV
Daily work with the founders, hybrid in Berlin

First call with a founder
A small technical screen: a working session in our codebase, with your tools

title: Working Student Data & AI (m/f/d)
description:
## About BetterDoc
We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers.
You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products.
## Our team
Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team.
We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote.
## Your mission
## Day-to-day work
• Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation.
• Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions.
• Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database.
## AI and prototypes
• Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script.
• Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients.

## Your profile
• You study medicine and are enrolled at a German university, ideally in the clinical phase.

• Technical curiosity: First experience with SQL, Python or databases is a plus, not a requirement.
• You are confident with spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets.
• You work carefully, in a structured and precise way and keep track even of larger datasets.
• Fluent German and good English.
• You enjoy working in a team and also independently.

• AI tools and time to experiment – Work with modern AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code, with room to try out new ideas.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
## Software Engineer, New Grad
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.
From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.
We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build the future of on-demand delivery, contributing to the services that power our global marketplace.
Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
## What You'll Be Doing
You'll be joining a high-impact engineering team at our London headquarters. As a New Grad, you will work on production systems that impact millions of users, supported by a world-class team of engineers.
## Here's what your day-to-day might look like:
Ship high-quality code: Improve code structure and contribute to the architecture of services using languages like Go, Ruby, Python, or Scala.
Own your features: Take ownership of specific pieces of work, assisting with design, technical implementation, and influencing your team's roadmap.
Operational excellence: Aim to simplify the maintenance and health of production systems, ensuring operational readiness and visibility.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Build relationships with other engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and solve complex marketplace problems.
Grow through mentorship: Benefit from the support of senior colleagues while eventually supporting the growth of your peers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
## What You'll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Foundational Knowledge: A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (graduated within the last year).
Software Craftsmanship: Pride in writing readable, well-designed, and thoroughly tested software.
Technical Curiosity: Experience writing web-based applications in any language and a strong interest in learning our stack (Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, or Rust).
Data Fundamentals: Familiarity with relational databases (such as PostgreSQL or MySQL).
Problem Solving: A proven ability to break down complex logistical or technical problems into manageable software solutions.
Right to Work: Applicants must be authorised to work in the U.K. to be considered for this position.
## Why Join Us?
At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.
Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
Here’s what this particular role covers.
## 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams
Our AI Platform engineering teams build the applications and services that help Wayve’s researchers and engineers develop, evaluate and test autonomous-driving models. The Model Development Platform turns complex experimentation, scheduling, evaluation and on-road testing workflows into intuitive products backed by scalable, secure services.
## 🧠 Your day-to-day
You will work across the full stack, from user discovery and interface design to APIs, backend services, data models and production operations. You will own significant capabilities end to end, influence technical direction and collaborate with Research, Product, Design, Operations and Engineering to improve how quickly advanced AI reaches real vehicles.
## 🧩 What you’ll be working on:
Design, build, deploy and operate full-stack applications for model development, evaluation and on-road testing.
Translate complex user workflows into intuitive interfaces, robust APIs, backend services and data models.
Own significant features and services from problem definition and design through implementation, observability and production support.
Build systems that are scalable, secure, reliable and performant as usage and complexity grow.
Partner across Research, Product, Design, Operations and Engineering to align solutions across team boundaries.
Lead design discussions and mentor other engineers through reviews, pairing and practical technical guidance.
## 🙌 You should apply if:
You have strong experience building and operating production web applications across frontend and backend systems.
You are proficient with modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, Flask or FastAPI, or comparable tools.
You bring sound system-design skills across APIs, data modelling, asynchronous workflows, testing, security and distributed systems.
You have taken ambiguous products or services from discovery through production operation.
You have influenced technical decisions and supported other engineers through design and code review.
You communicate effectively across functions and use practical judgement about delivery, maintainability, reliability and user value.
## 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay!
If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
## More about Wayve:
🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
## How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:
Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
## 🔍 The Interview Process:
Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)
Deep-dive technical interviews (programming, systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)
Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour).
We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
## What’s in it for you (Location dependant):
💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
A quick, honest note before you apply.
Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve
DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Stage Data Scientist - Forecast & Foundation Models (f/h/d)
description:
DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nous voulons permettre à nos clients de vivre l'expérience Decathlon à travers de nombreuses expériences locales centrées sur le sport en connectant de nombreux acteurs et services tiers, de manière sécurisée et performante.

Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Forecast (H/F) pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, nos équipes en magasin ont besoin d'outils prédictifs performants pour anticiper leur activité et adapter leur organisation au quotidien. Aujourd'hui, l'optimisation des plannings, la prévision d'affluence et l'anticipation de la charge de travail représentent des défis majeurs d'échelle et de précision.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de participer à l'amélioration, à l'évaluation et au passage à l'échelle de nos modèles de prévision déjà en production, en explorant notamment l'apport des nouveaux modèles de fondation temporels et tabulaires.

L'enjeu : réaliser un état de l'art des solutions émergentes, adapter ces modèles à nos problématiques réelles complexes et structurer un framework de benchmark robuste pour valider scientifiquement les meilleures approches.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la mise en production :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les nouvelles approches de modèles de fondation pour séries temporelles et données tabulaires (TSFM / TabFM).
  • Spécialisation et adaptation : Entraîner, spécialiser (fine-tuning) et adapter ces modèles de fondation aux contraintes opérationnelles réelles du retail.
  • Framework de benchmark et d'évaluation : Concevoir un cadre de test standardisé et structurer des jeux de données réels pour comparer objectivement les performances des différents modèles.
  • Optimisation des modèles prédictifs : Participer à l'amélioration de nos modèles prédictifs actuellement en production.
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes travaux de manière claire et évaluer, selon les résultats et tes appétences, l'opportunité d'une publication scientifique ou technique.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, Hugging Face, benchmarks de modèles de fondation (ex. GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

 CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Mathématiques Appliquées, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en statistiques, Machine Learning et Deep Learning.
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes de séries temporelles en environnement réel.

 CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.
